crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

faqs.a: It depends on the scope — share what you need and I'll give you a range.
Usually within a few days. Tell me your timeline and I'll confirm.

escalation.when: anything the price list doesn't cover

agents.name: Sales
agents.instructions: Answer the price question from the catalogue, then move one step towards the order.
never: Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

agents.name: Support
agents.instructions: Solve the problem first, sell nothing, and hand off when a human decision is needed.
never: Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.

agents.name: Booking
agents.instructions: Offer real slots only, confirm the time, and hand off when the calendar and the customer disagree.
never: Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
